title: A milestone's own description claims a milestone number that doesn't exist
author: kwaku-ananse
description: Extracts every 'milestone #N' claim phrase (the shared seam_engine.milestone_claims grammar) from a milestone's own description and checks whether the named milestone exists at all. milestone-claims-open-milestone's own docstring named this exact seam and left it open on purpose: a claimed milestone number that names no real milestone at all was excluded there as belonging to 'milestone-body-dangling-reference's own seam, not this one's.' A live recheck (task 870) found that deferral had never actually been built for the milestone number space: milestone-body-dangling-reference watches a bare #N against the shared GitHub issue/PR number sequence and never opens ListMilestones. This recipe is that seam, on the second of the five sources task 870 named and left open (milestone, readme, release, tweet remained after mention-claims-dangling-milestone closed the first) -- the milestone-sourced sibling of commit-claims-dangling-milestone, issue-comment-claims-dangling-milestone, review-comment-claims-dangling-milestone, slack-message-claims-dangling-milestone, linear-comment-claims-dangling-milestone, and mention-claims-dangling-milestone. Not whether a real milestone's claim is TRUE (milestone-claims-open-milestone's own remit), but whether the number the claim names resolves to anything real. Same-list comparison, the shape milestone-claims-open-milestone already established: every milestone in the fixture plays both the claimant and a possible target for some OTHER milestone's claim.
confidence_notes: Flat 0.8, not age-gated -- mirrors commit-claims-dangling-milestone's/issue-comment-claims-dangling-milestone's/review-comment-claims-dangling-milestone's/slack-message-claims-dangling-milestone's/linear-comment-claims-dangling-milestone's/mention-claims-dangling-milestone's own reasoning rather than milestone-claims-open-milestone's 24-hour edit-grace bar: an OPEN milestone could close at any moment, so a fresh claim about it might just be a race the description hasn't caught up to yet, but a milestone number that does not exist right now will not spontaneously start existing later, so there is no grace period that means anything here. A claimed milestone number that DOES resolve to a real milestone is excluded at confidence 0.0 regardless of whether that milestone is open or closed -- whether the claim is true is milestone-claims-open-milestone's own seam, not this one's. A milestone claiming ITSELF is excluded at confidence 0.0 -- not a claim about a second record, so no seam. A milestone with no 'milestone #N' claim phrase at all, or no description at all, produces no surfaced candidate -- there is no claim to have broken.
